meta.title: Hestia — Food, chemistry & safety assistant
meta.description: Understand your ingredients, the chemistry behind cooking, and how to cook with confidence.

auth.title: Welcome to Hestia
auth.description: Sign in to start a conversation with your food and culinary-safety assistant.
auth.signInFailed: Sign-in is unavailable right now. Please try again.
auth.privacy: Hestia uses Firebase only for authentication. Your account profile is not copied into a Hestia database.

welcome.title: What are we cooking today?
welcome.description: Share a photo or tell me what you have. I’ll help you understand the ingredients, check meaningful risks, and turn them into a practical meal.
welcome.scanDescription: Upload a photo and identify what is on your counter.
welcome.scanPrompt: What ingredients are in this image?
welcome.safetyDescription: Review relevant cooking, storage, and chemistry risks.
welcome.safetyPrompt: Help me check whether the food I want to cook is safe.
welcome.chemistryDescription: See why a reaction matters without the textbook language.
welcome.chemistryPrompt: Explain the food chemistry behind the dish I want to cook.

composer.placeholder: Ask about your ingredients or the dish you want to cook…

ingredients.eyebrow: A clearer view of your kitchen
ingredients.title: Ingredient pantry
ingredients.description: Track what you have, combine ingredients, and ask Hestia about dishes, safety, or cooking chemistry.
ingredients.emptyDescription: Add ingredients one by one or snap a photo of your counter. For now, this data stays only in this browser.
ingredients.localStorageNote: This prototype stores ingredients locally per account in this browser. The storage layer can be replaced by PostgreSQL later.

form.description: Describe its real condition so Hestia understands the context.
form.name: Ingredient name
form.notePlaceholder: Use-by date, opened pack, cooking plan…

detail.disclaimer: This is a reference summary. Ask Hestia with a specific cooking method for a contextual analysis.

lab.title: Cooking laboratory
lab.description: Try a cooking condition and have Hestia analyze reactions, quality, and risk.
lab.disclaimer: Appliance temperature is not always the food's core temperature. Measure the food when safety depends on doneness.

prompts.recipes: I have these ingredients: {ingredients}. Suggest 3 practical dishes, list anything missing, estimate time, and flag important safety notes.
prompts.safety: Check food safety for these ingredients: {ingredients}. Prioritize risks from condition, storage, cross-contamination, and doneness; distinguish what is known from what needs more context.
prompts.compare: Compare the culinary role, nutrition, cooking reactions, and compatibility of these ingredients: {ingredients}. Keep it concise and practical.
prompts.lab: Analyze a cooking experiment using {ingredients}: {method} at about {temperature}°C for {duration} minutes. Explain structural changes, likely chemical reactions, expected quality, and safety risks. Suggest adjustments where useful.
prompts.detail: Analyze {ingredient}: selection, storage, preparation, notable cooking reactions, and evidence-based safety considerations.
